_comment: IDENTITY LOCK v2 (bad-boy motorcycle archetype). Every prompt is assembled from these strings. Fields listed in 'immutable' never change across the 90 days. Change only deliberately, then regenerate the reference sheet. Original fictional character: no real person, character or creator is used as a face, identity or style source.

archetype.primary: bad boy + motorcycle + black leather jacket + dark romantic + dominant masculine + wealthy + mysterious
archetype.signature_combo: dark short slightly wet hair, sharp intense eyes, fair skin, strong jaw, broad shoulders, athletic lean-muscular build, black leather motorcycle jacket, satin-black motorcycle, controlled dominant expression
archetype.not: generic AI handsome rich guy; biker-gang cliché; motorcycle-only account; toxic or violent

elias.face: fair light skin with realistic texture and faint pores, sharp masculine bone structure, strong defined jaw, straight narrow nose, intense slightly hooded dark brown eyes with naturally shadowed lash line (no makeup), thick straight dark eyebrows, light stubble
elias.hair: short dark brown-black hair, slightly wet-looking and messy, textured on top falling slightly forward, shorter on the sides, natural hairline
elias.body: broad shoulders, athletic lean-muscular build, defined but not bulky, narrow waist, about 188 cm tall impression, upright controlled posture
elias.expression_default: controlled, quietly dominant expression, calm unreadable eyes
elias.short_lock: 29-year-old man, fair skin, short dark slightly wet messy hair, sharp jaw, straight narrow nose, intense hooded dark eyes, thick dark brows, broad shoulders, athletic lean-muscular build

signature_jacket.lock: his signature black leather motorcycle jacket: aged soft black cowhide with a subtle natural sheen, asymmetric zip, snap-down lapels, fitted at the shoulders and cropped at the waist, matte black hardware, no patches, no logos, no studs
signature_jacket.frequency: about 35-40% of posts where he is in frame; at least 2 per week; never more than 3 in-frame posts in a row; always on rides
signature_jacket.rule: The jacket never changes: same leather, same zip, same collar, same fit. Only what is under it changes.

accessories.watch: understated steel watch with a plain black dial and black leather strap, no visible branding, left wrist
accessories.ring: simple matte black band on the right ring finger
accessories.helmet: matte black full-face motorcycle helmet with dark smoked visor, no graphics or logos
accessories.gloves: black leather riding gloves, short cuff, no logos

wardrobe.W01: black fitted shirt with top button open, black tailored trousers
wardrobe.W02: black single-breasted suit, black shirt, no tie
wardrobe.W03: white-cream cotton shirt, sleeves rolled to the forearm, dark tailored trousers
wardrobe.W04: the signature black leather motorcycle jacket over a plain black crewneck T-shirt, black slim trousers, black leather boots
wardrobe.W05: premium plain black heavyweight T-shirt, charcoal trousers
wardrobe.W07: relaxed travel outfit: dark overshirt, plain tee, soft trousers, leather weekender
wardrobe.W08: the signature black leather motorcycle jacket zipped, black leather riding gloves, dark slim jeans, black riding boots
wardrobe.W09: long black wool overcoat over black knit
wardrobe.W10: black evening tuxedo, black bow tie loosened
wardrobe.W11: the signature black leather motorcycle jacket open over a white or cream shirt, dark trousers (romantic / evening variant)

girlfriend._rule: Codename is internal only. Never published. Her name, face and identity are never fully revealed in this 90-day arc.
girlfriend.hair: dark brown medium-long hair with soft natural waves
girlfriend.style: elegant understated style in cream, camel and black, minimal makeup
girlfriend.body: slim, graceful, recognisable silhouette, about 168 cm
girlfriend.signatures: thin gold chain bracelet with a small oval charm on her left wrist, tan structured leather shoulder bag
girlfriend.lock: woman with dark brown medium-long softly waved hair, elegant understated cream-and-camel clothing, thin gold chain bracelet with a small oval charm on her left wrist

visibility.absent: her presence implied only by an object (her tan leather bag, a second cup, her bracelet); she is not in frame
visibility.hand: only her hand and wrist with the gold bracelet are visible
visibility.silhouette: she appears only as a soft silhouette, face not readable
visibility.back: she is seen from behind, face not visible
visibility.partial: her face is partly visible: cropped, turned away or softly out of focus, never fully identifiable
visibility.behind_camera: she is the photographer, not in frame; framing feels personal and affectionate

motorcycle.lock: satin-black premium modern naked sport motorcycle, aggressive but realistic angular LED headlight with thin daytime running lights, muscular sculpted tank, short raised tail with minimal tail light, black upside-down front forks, blacked-out frame, engine and wheels, short black underbelly exhaust, compact black seat, minimal unreadable branding
motorcycle.rule: One motorcycle for the whole account: same silhouette, colour, headlight, tank, tail and exhaust. Never a café racer, cruiser, dirt bike or a different colour. No readable manufacturer badges.
motorcycle.second_helmet: matte cream open-face helmet with brown leather strap

recurring_objects.book: a worn hardcover book with a deep green cloth cover and no readable title
recurring_objects.matchbook: a black restaurant matchbook with an unreadable gold mark
recurring_objects.postcard: a faded vintage postcard, location text obscured
recurring_objects.old_photo: a faded old photograph of an empty coastal road at dusk
recurring_objects.hotel_key: a brass hotel room key with a leather tag, number partly hidden by his thumb
recurring_objects.cream_helmet: a matte cream open-face helmet with a brown leather strap

variable.stubble: light stubble to short stubble; never clean-shaven baby face, never full beard
variable.hair_state: damp/wet-look, dry-messy or pushed back by a helmet; cut and length never change
variable.outfit: any wardrobe code W01-W11; jacket frequency rule applies
variable.expression: controlled by default; rare half-smile (romance); rare direct stare (Days 1, 87, 90)
variable.face_visibility: full, direct, away, partial, back, none (per calendar)
variable.girlfriend_visibility: none → absent → hand → silhouette → back → behind_camera → partial
variable.minor_body_marks: at most a faint trace of chain grease or a healed graze, dark-phase only; never fight wounds, never graphic

realism_suffix: photorealistic, natural skin texture, true-to-life proportions, physically plausible lighting and reflections, anatomically correct hands with five fingers, no text, no logos, no watermark
negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, illustration, 3d render, CGI, plastic skin, airbrushed, over-smoothed, uncanny, doll-like, extra fingers, fused fingers, malformed hands, distorted face, asymmetrical eyes, different face, heterochromia, blue eyes, green eyes, blond hair, long hair, bodybuilder, oversized muscles, visible makeup, eyeliner, brand logos, readable text, watermark, signature, warped reflections, duplicate person, deformed motorcycle, cafe racer, cruiser, chopper, dirt bike, brown leather jacket, studded jacket, patches, biker gang vest, clean-shaven, full beard
